title: Lead II - Business Analysis
description:
**Role Description**
Who We Are
  
  
At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our clients to co-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact, touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at UST.com.
  
  
**Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst to bridge business needs and technology solutions within Insurance, Wealth Management, and Financial Services domains. The ideal candidate will be responsible for requirements gathering, business process analysis, stakeholder management, Agile delivery support, and ensuring business objectives are translated into clear, actionable requirements. This role requires close collaboration with Product Owners, Architects, Developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to drive successful project outcomes while maintaining compliance and governance standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Elicit, analyze, document, and manage business and functional requirements.
* Create detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and maintain product backlogs.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Conduct process analysis, process modeling, and identify opportunities for business process improvement.
* Perform data analysis, data mapping, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Manage requirements traceability from inception through implementation and testing.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test scenario creation, execution coordination, validation, and stakeholder sign-off.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, governance, audit, and risk management requirements.
* Analyze business impacts, identify gaps, and recommend effective solutions.
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions, workshops, and requirements sessions.
* Mentor and guide junior Business Analysts while providing functional leadership.
* Support system integration initiatives involving APIs and enterprise applications.
* Prepare business documentation, process flows, and project artifacts using industry-standard tools.

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience in gathering, eliciting, and documenting business and functional requirements from key stakeholders.
* Proven ability to manage requirements throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* Expertise in creating detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and business process documentation.
* Experience maintaining and prioritizing product backlogs in collaboration with Product Owners.
* Ability to define and document both functional and non-functional requirements for complex business applications.
* Strong understanding of business process analysis and continuous process improvement methodologies.
* Experience managing end-to-end requirements traceability from initiation through deployment.
* Strong experience in data analysis, data mapping, and business data validation activities.
* Working knowledge of SQL and reporting tools for data extraction, analysis, and reporting.
* Understanding of APIs, system integrations, and enterprise application workflows.
* Experience creating process models, workflow diagrams, and business flow documentation using tools such as Visio or Lucidchart.
* Hands-on experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test scenario creation, execution, and business validation.
* Proficiency in Jira and Confluence for requirements management, Agile delivery, and project documentation.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio.
* Hands-on experience working within Agile delivery environments and Scrum frameworks.
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Product Owners, Architects, Developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders.
* Strong experience coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure timely project delivery.
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and end-to-end delivery management practices.
* Ability to manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and project deliverables in fast-paced environments.
* Strong understanding of Insurance business processes, products, and operational workflows.
* Experience within Wealth Management and Financial Services organizations.
* Knowledge of regulatory compliance, audit requirements, and governance frameworks.
* Familiarity with risk management practices and controls within regulated financial environments.
* Understanding of insurance policy administration, claims, underwriting, and customer servicing processes.
* Experience working with US Supplemental Health and Worksite Insurance products is highly preferred.
* Exposure to insurance platforms such as Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, EIS, and wMA is an added advantage.
* Banking domain experience will also be considered highly relevant.

**Preferred Qualifications Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in Insurance, Financial Services, or Wealth Management organizations.
* Proven experience working with Agile delivery teams and enterprise-scale transformation programs.
* Experience mentoring junior analysts and leading business analysis activities across multiple projects.

What We Believe
  
  
We’re proud to embrace the same values that have shaped UST since the beginning. Since day one, we’ve been building enduring relationships and a culture of integrity. Today, those same values inspire us to encourage innovation from everyone, champion diversity and inclusion, and place people at the center of everything we do.
  
  
Humility
  
  
We will listen, learn, be empathetic, and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.
  
  
Humanity
  
  
Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.
  
  
Integrity
  
  
We honour our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
  
  
UST is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences, such as age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, religion, or sexual orientation.
  
  
All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, colour, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
  
  
UST reserves the right to periodically redefine your roles and responsibilities based on organizational requirements and/or performance.
  
  

* To support and promote the values of UST.
* Comply with all Company policies and procedures.

**Skills**
Skills
  
  
Business Analysis,Requirements Gathering & Management,Agile & Scrum,User Story Creation,Backlog Management,Process Improvement,Data Analysis & Data Mapping,UAT,Stakeholder Management,Financial Services or Banking Domain

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. title: Senior Associate - Strategic Planning & Operations
description:
**Job Description**
Increasing demand for observational research (now commonly referred to as real-world evidence [RWE]) from regulatory and reimbursement authorities makes observational research a key component of drug development and commercialization. Amgen's Center for Observational Research (CfOR) is a global organization with an industry-leading analytical capability that generates RWE to support business needs across a product’s lifecycle. CfOR scientists partner with internal stakeholders and industry experts to design, conduct, interpret and publish observational research that informs decision-making from the early development of a molecule to the design of clinical trials and the safety and efficacy of Amgen medicines.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Senior Associate, Strategic Planning & Operations**
, to join the Center for Observational Research (CfOR). This role will work with other Amgen functional teams to oversee and drive execution of CfOR’s operational projects and non-interventional studies ensuring timely completion within budget and at the highest quality with compliance. This role requires strong project management capabilities combined with a growth mindset and openness to leveraging emerging AI tools to improve productivity and drive CfOR-wide initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support end-to-end operational workflows/ automate tools and standardise process maps / SOPs to improve efficiency in CfOR operational process such as budget management, contracting, dashboard management and project management/ PMO office.
* Driving AI-enabled operational transformation to enhance efficiency in compliance process, budget tracking, and decision-making across global CfOR programs
* Project management including project planning, governance tracking, milestone management, Vendor onboarding, risk/issue tracking, and stakeholder reporting
* SharePoint management experience in content governance to enable effective collaboration and efficient document control.
* Knowledge management/ training capabilities - Design, track knowledge-sharing metrics and drive team engagement with continuous learning frameworks.

**Operational Excellence & Process Optimization:**

* Automate / standardize end-to-end workflows & process maps to improve efficiency in CFOR operational process
* Drive execution of operational processes by monitoring budgets, contracts, study milestones, risks, and performance metrics while ensuring data accuracy, timely reporting, and adherence to regulatory, compliance and organizational requirements.
* Ensure quality, compliance, and alignment with global operational standards
* Strong experience in SharePoint management, including site administration, document libraries, permission management, and content governance to enable secure collaboration and efficient document control

**AI & Digital Enablement:**

* Applied generative AI tools to improve productivity in documentation and operations
* Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and standardize workflows
* Creating dashboards of operational processes
* Drove adoption and migration of digital tools (Smartsheet, MS tools, Teams, SharePoint, Miro, lucid) for collaboration and tracking
* Develop apps/ AI chatbots / migrate available processes to new technology/ tools based on organizational requirements

**Project Management Office**

* Demonstrated experience in PMO practices, including project planning, governance tracking, milestone management, stakeholder reporting, ensuring timely delivery, quality, and alignment with business priorities.
* Ability to apply Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid project management methodologies to improve execution, collaboration, and operational efficiency and improve project visibility and execution tracking.

**Data, Reporting & Dashboarding:**

* Developed and maintained operational dashboards and reports (Power BI/Excel/Smartsheet) to track study performance, resource utilization, and key KPIs
* Delivered actionable insights through data analysis and reporting to support leadership decision-making

**Financial & Resource Management:**

* Managed financial operations including PO processing, invoice verification, and expense tracking using SAP/Ariba/Anaplan
* Supported budget planning and resource management across programs

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of Clinical / Scientific Operations experience OR
* Master’s degree and 5+ years of Scientific or Operations experience
* Pharma/ Healthcare degree with application of technology/ AI knowledge expertise, advanced excel knowledge, dashboard creation for reporting, and decision support.

**Preferred Qualifications/Skills:**

* Minimum of 6 years of project management experience, Agile Scrum master, with +4 years in pharma/biotech and cross-functional environments. Project planning & milestone tracking, process standardization & optimization, KPI design & reporting, cross-functional stakeholder management
* Technical: SQL, Python (incl. applied ML/predictive modeling), Tableau, Power BI & Analytics, Advanced Excel, Dashboard Creation & Reporting
* Hands-on experience with budgeting, contracting, PMO office, and working in regulated document management systems
* Drive AI-enabled operational transformation to enhance efficiency in CFoR operational process
* Demonstrated proficiency & adaptability with related software tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Smartsheet, Miro, SharePoint, MS Teams, Office 365, etc.)
* Quick learner with strong analytical skills and adaptability to new tools and concepts
* Demonstrates autonomy and reliability in managing tasks and contributing to team goals
* Highly organized, with the ability to prioritize and deliver on projects independently or collaboratively
* Effective communicator with strong written, verbal, and presentation abilities
* Builds positive relationships and fosters collaboration with a proactive, “can-do” attitude
* Familiarity with drug commercialization & business practices

title: Digital Product Mgr-AI&D
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**Digital Product Manager (AI)**
The Digital Product Manager at Amgen oversees the lifecycle of digital products, working closely with various teams to define the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Digital Product Manager, to join the AI & Data Innovation Lab Product Management Team. This role is focused on rapidly validating high-potential AI and data-driven business opportunities before major investment, helping Amgen determine which AI initiatives should be scaled, refined, paused, or redirected.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of business strategy, AI product innovation, data, technology, and enterprise transformation, this role will provide strategic product leadership across ambiguous, cross-functional opportunities and influence senior business and technology stakeholders on product direction, prioritization, investment, and scale.
  
  
This role requires a strong product mindset, sufficient technical depth to evaluate whether AI and data opportunities are practical, scalable, measurable, and aligned to Amgen’s enterprise technology direction. The successful candidate will understand how AI products are built, validated, deployed, monitored, and scaled in complex enterprise environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design and execute rapid discovery sprints, prototypes, pilots, user research, and experiments to assess desirability, feasibility, viability, value, and risk. Use evidence to determine whether opportunities should advance, pivot, pause, or scale.
* Identify, frame, and validate AI-enabled business opportunities across Amgen. Translate broad transformation themes into clear problem statements, testable hypotheses, user needs, data requirements, success metrics, and validation plans.
* Assess how LLMs, AI agents, machine learning models, NLP, automation, knowledge retrieval, analytics, and intelligent workflow tools can improve productivity, decision quality, scientific discovery, operational efficiency, and workforce effectiveness.
* Evaluate whether proposed AI opportunities have the right data foundations, system integrations, architecture patterns, model capabilities, security controls, and operational support needed to move from concept to scalable solution.
* Partner with engineering, data science, and technical teams to align on scope, tradeoffs, and execution path.
* Conduct landscape assessments across different industries to learn how AI is leveraged to solve shared problem spaces at the macro level.
* Develop product requirements that account for user experience, data availability, model performance, output quality, explainability, reliability, latency, integration needs, governance, and ongoing measurement.
* Synthesize findings from validation work into clear product recommendations, opportunity briefs, technical feasibility assessments, business cases, and executive-ready narratives. Help leaders make informed decisions about where to invest, scale, or stop.
* Ensure validation efforts consider responsible AI, data privacy, model risk, cybersecurity, compliance, regulatory considerations, human oversight, change management, and enterprise scalability from the earliest stages of discovery.
* Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, prioritization discussions, technical feasibility reviews, user experience design, process mapping, and decision forums. Communicate complex AI and data concepts in a clear, business-oriented way for senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 8-13 years of work experience in the related field
* Doctorate; or Master’s degree and 2 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* Associate’s degree and 8 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* High School Diploma or GED and 10 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of product management, product strategy, innovation, consulting, digital transformation, or related experience.
* 2+ years of experience with AI, machine learning, data products, automation, LLMs, agents, NLP, analytics, or enterprise AI solutions.
* Working knowledge of AI product development, including discovery, prototyping, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
* Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, prompt engineering, model orchestration, NLP, predictive analytics, or intelligent automation.
* Design thinking experience
* Ability to evaluate AI opportunities across desirability, feasibility, viability, value, risk, scalability, and data readiness.
* Experience with AI platforms, MLOps, or enterprise AI architecture.
* Familiarity with AI (e.g., LLMs, agents, NLP) and ML productization at scale.
* Strong presentation and public speaking skills with experience communicating to executives
* Familiarity with biotech workflows (e.g., lab automation, computational biology, clinical data, etc).
* Hands-on ability to analyze product usage, model output quality, or design A/B experiments.
* Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments where priorities evolve quickly.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively across functions and levels.
* Consulting experience, with demonstrated ability to structure and solve complex business problems.
* Experience conducting cross-industry landscape assessments to identify how AI is being leveraged to address shared problem spaces and uncover macro-level trends and opportunities

**Job Description**
**At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything.**

Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity.
  
  
**Sub Function**
Full Stack Engineering, Digital Product Engineering & Cloud Applications
  
  
**Location**
Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**Reports To**
Director ICC
  
  
**Position Overview**
Johnson & Johnson is seeking a highly motivated Manager, Full Stack Engineering to lead the design, development, modernization, and delivery of enterprise digital products and cloud-native applications that support business-critical capabilities across Clinical Development, R&D, Medical Affairs, and enterprise technology organizations.
  
  
This role will provide people leadership and technical direction for full stack engineering teams responsible for delivering secure, scalable, and user-centric applications. The successful candidate will partner with product managers, architects, data and AI teams, business stakeholders, cybersecurity, quality, and platform engineering teams to build modern solutions that improve productivity, decision-making, and digital user experiences.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings strong engineering leadership, hands-on knowledge of modern front-end and back-end technologies, cloud-native architecture, API design, Agile delivery, DevSecOps, and regulated technology delivery practices.

title: Implementation Consultant
description:
**About Us**
HighRadius provides a single Agentic AI platform for the Office of the CFO. It integrates 180+ agents that orchestrate end-to-end processes across Order-to-Cash, Close & Reconciliation, Consolidation & Reporting, Accounts Payable, B2B Payments, and Treasury. HighRadius guarantees operational KPI improvements by mapping them to specific agents on the platform. With a 3-6 month go-live period, HighRadius drives value creation at 1300+ enterprises such as 3M, Unilever, Bristol-Myers Squibb Company, Red Bull, Lufthansa, and more. HighRadius has been consistently recognized as a market leader by Gartner, IDC, and Forrester.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Consultant will be responsible for owning and executing HighRadius Cloud product implementations for Fortune 2000 clients. The Consultant is responsible for delivering the project with good quality, high value and great customer satisfaction within the project timelines. This job profile will offer an individual high visibility with regular client interaction as he/she will be the main Point of Contact during Build, Testing and Hypercare phases of Highradius Product Implementation. The candidate must be well organized, detail oriented and possess excellent communication skills.
  
  
**Skills And Experience Needed**

* Carry out end-to-end client implementation of HighRadius Cloud products for Fortune 2000 companies across the globe.
* Writing SQL scripts for data gathering and configuration.
* Run and execute the project through the various phases of the project life cycle including Requirement Gathering, Design, Configuration, Testing, Cutover, Go-live and Hyper-care.
* Able to build rapport with clients and manage them effectively. Will require to conduct UAT and support shadow sessions with clients effectively.
* Closely collaborate with cross functional teams such as Product Management, Engineering, Technical teams & QA to deploy the projects with the agreed KPIs
* Test end-to-end Process flows, drive adoption by giving hand-on end user journey training and validate value outcomes
* Keep the Delivery Manager and/or Program Director honest and up to date on any potential risks related to Project Implementation

**Job Specification**

* 3-6 years of professional services experience
* Bachelor's or Master’s Degree (preferably from a top reputed university)
* Good understanding of SDLC processes and Functional Consulting experience,
* Very good communication, Analytical, problem solving, presentation, Organizational and Collaboration skills
* Exposure to international clients / projects, Exposure to BA, Domain Knowledge, Team player
* Experience with Order-to-Cash(O2C) related business process is a plus

**What You’ll Get**

* Competitive salary.
* Fun-filled work culture (https://www.highradius.com/culture/)
* Equal employment opportunities.
* Opportunity to build with a pre-IPO Global SaaS Centaur.

title: Architect - Identity & Access Management
description:
**Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Senior IAM Analyst to lead and coordinate Identity and Access Management (IAM) initiatives across multiple business programs, applications, platforms, and transformation projects.
  
  
This role will serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, application teams, project managers, architects, cybersecurity teams, and IAM engineering teams to ensure successful delivery of IAM requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for understanding project scope, business requirements, timelines, dependencies, risks, and implementation plans while driving IAM workstreams to completion. The role requires strong stakeholder management, program coordination, requirement gathering, documentation, reporting, and IAM domain knowledge.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines project delivery discipline with practical IAM expertise across Identity Lifecycle Management, SSO, MFA, PAM, Directory Services, and Access Governance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
IAM Program & Project Management
  
  

* Manage and coordinate multiple IAM-related initiatives simultaneously.
* Act as the primary point of contact between business/application teams and IAM teams.
* Understand project scope, objectives, timelines, milestones, and dependencies.
* Ensure IAM requirements are identified early and incorporated into project plans.
* Track project deliverables, risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Drive project execution and ensure timely closure of IAM action items.
* Facilitate governance meetings, project updates, and status reviews.
* Escalate critical risks and blockers appropriately.

Business Engagement & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional and security requirements.
* Collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, cloud teams, cybersecurity teams, and external vendors.
* Act as a trusted advisor for IAM-related requirements and best practices.
* Develop strong relationships with project sponsors and key stakeholders.
* Drive alignment across multiple cross-functional teams.
* Manage stakeholder communications and expectations.

IAM Requirements & Solution Coordination
  
  

* 9+ yrs of experience in Gather, analyse, and document IAM requirements.
* Translate business requirements into IAM implementation requirements.
* Partner with IAM architects and engineering teams to define solutions.
* Validate proposed IAM designs align with business and security objectives.
* Coordinate implementation activities across teams.

Documentation & Governance
  
  
Responsible for creation and maintenance of:
  
  

* Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Requirements Documents (FRD), User Stories, Solution Design Documents, Process Flows, AM Architecture Inputs, Change Management Documentation, Operational Runbooks, Implementation Plans,Test Plans, Cutover Plans, Support Handover Documentation

Ensure all documentation is maintained according to enterprise standards.
  
  
Project Planning & Execution
  
  

* Create and maintain project plans and implementation schedules.
* Support planning and dependency management.
* Coordinate project milestones and readiness activities.
* Ensure adherence to delivery timelines.
* Monitor progress and provide regular reporting to leadership.

Reporting & Metrics
  
  

* Develop executive and operational status reports.
* Provide dashboards and reporting on:
* Present updates to leadership and governance forums.

Change Management & Transition
  
  

* Facilitate transition from project teams to support teams.
* Ensure proper documentation and knowledge transfer.

Mergers, Acquisitions & Divestitures (M&A)
  
  

* Support IAM workstreams for M&A initiatives.
* Participate in due diligence activities.
* Support Day-1 readiness and transition activities.

**Qualifications**
Strong understanding and Hands-on of IAM concepts including:
  
  
Identity Management
  
  

* Identity Lifecycle Management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver), User Provisioning and Deprovisioning, Role Management, Access Certification, Access Governance

Authentication & Access
  
  

* Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Passwordless Authentication, Federation, Conditional Access, OAuth, OIDC, SAML

Privileged Access Management
  
  

* Privileged Account Governance, Secrets Management, Service Accounts, Privileged Session Management

Directory Services
  
  

* Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), LDAP, Identity Synchronization

Cloud & SaaS
  
  

* AWS, Azure, GCP, Enterprise SaaS Applications

Documentation Skills
  
  

* BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Process Documentation, Runbooks, SOPs, Operational Documentation

Reporting
  
  

* Executive Reporting, Dashboard Creation, KPI Tracking, Metrics Analysis

title: Salesforce Technical Lead
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company’s patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
  
  
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Manager / Technical Lead to lead a high-performing Marketing Cloud and Experience Cloud team while serving as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders. This role requires strong people management, clear communication, and the ability to guide teams through complex architecture, development, delivery oversight, and strategic partnership. The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader and effective people manager who can mentor development teams, communicate complex ideas with clarity, drive innovation, and partner with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable, impactful solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Experience Cloud developers, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee project delivery to ensure solutions are delivered on time, within budget, and at the highest quality standards.
* Manage project priorities, resource allocation, timelines, and client expectations across multiple engagements.
* Conduct code reviews and enforce development standards, best practices, and governance policies.
* Monitor team performance, utilization, and project metrics to drive operational excellence.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Aura, and Visualforce.
* Architect enterprise-grade solutions that effectively balance custom development with Salesforce platform capabilities and low-code/no-code approaches.
* Ensure adherence to Salesforce security, performance, data integrity, and platform architecture best practices.
* Lead integrations with third-party applications and services using APIs, Apex, and JavaScript frameworks.
* Partner closely with business teams on an ongoing basis to assess business challenges and recommend strategic Salesforce solutions that deliver measurable value.
* Present completed solutions and articulate technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders and technical audiences.
* Identify opportunities to expand client engagements and contribute to strategic revenue growth initiatives.
* Stay current with Salesforce platform releases, emerging technologies, and industry best practices.
* Evaluate and implement new tools, frameworks, and Salesforce capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and solution quality.
* Coach, mentor, and support professional development for junior and mid-level associates.
* Encourage certification attainment and continuous technical learning across the team.

Required Skills and Experience
  
  

* 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including required experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud and Marketing Cloud.
* Proven experience leading and developing technical teams.
* Expert knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Salesforce Data Model, and Salesforce Security Model.
* Experience with Salesforce DX, Git version control, CI/CD deployment methodologies, and REST/SOAP APIs.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce platform architecture, governor limits, and scalable design principles.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining quality and client satisfaction.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce Platform Developer I and/or II certifications.
* Experience implementing enterprise integration and design patterns within Salesforce.
* Familiarity with UX/UI principles and the Lightning Design System.
* Experience working within Agile and EOS-based delivery environments.
* Experience supporting healthcare and pharmaceuticals.

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Java Technical Lead
description:
IC Markets Global is one of the most renowned Forex CFD provider, offering trading solutions for active day traders and scalpers as well as traders that are new to the forex market. IC Markets Global offers its clients cutting edge trading platforms, low latency connectivity and superior liquidity.

IC Markets Global is revolutionizing online forex trading. Traders are now able to gain access to pricing previously only available to investment banks and high net worth individuals.

Our management team have significant experience in the Forex, CFD and Equity markets in Asia, Europe and North America. It is this experience that has enabled us to select the best possible technology solutions and hand pick some of the best pricing providers available in the market.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a
**Technical Team Lead – Java**
with strong hands-on backend development experience, proven technical leadership capabilities, and the ability to lead and manage a full engineering team end to end.

The ideal candidate will come from a
**Fintech, Forex, Trading, or high-performance systems environment**
, with strong experience in
**Java, microservices architecture, API development, backend integrations, low-latency systems, and cloud-based delivery**
.

This is a critical leadership role within the engineering organization. The person will be responsible not only for hands-on technical guidance, but also for ensuring the team is properly structured, aligned, productive, and delivering according to business priorities. The role requires someone who can stay fully on top of team activities, break down work, assign responsibilities, remove blockers, challenge estimates, monitor progress, and ensure delivery commitments are met.

The Technical Team Lead will act as the main point of reference for the team from a technical and delivery perspective, working closely with Product, QA, DevOps, Mobile, Trading, Risk, and other business stakeholders.

The person should be able to lead with minimal supervision, take full ownership of the team’s technical direction, and ensure engineering standards, delivery quality, and operational reliability are consistently maintained.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Team Leadership & Ownership**

* Lead, mentor, and guide a team of Java backend developers.
* Take ownership of the team’s day-to-day execution, priorities, delivery progress, and technical output.
* Ensure all team members have clear responsibilities, priorities, and expected deliverables.
* Break down technical work into clear tasks and assign them effectively across the team.
* Monitor team progress closely and proactively identify delays, risks, dependencies, and blockers.
* Act as the first escalation point for the team and help unblock issues quickly.
* Ensure the team is working efficiently, with clear communication and accountability.
* Support onboarding, knowledge sharing, coaching, and continuous development of team members.
* Promote ownership, collaboration, technical discipline, and a delivery-focused mindset within the team.

**2. Technical Leadership**

* Provide strong technical direction across backend systems, integrations, and trading-related services.
* Lead technical design discussions and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with business needs.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure engineering standards, best practices, and clean coding principles are followed.
* Challenge technical decisions where needed and ensure the team follows the correct architecture and implementation approach.
* Support developers with complex technical issues and ensure the right solutions are implemented.
* Drive technical documentation, implementation plans, and knowledge sharing across the team.
* Ensure technical decisions are clearly communicated to Product, QA, DevOps, and other stakeholders.

**3. Backend Architecture & Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java, preferably Java 17+.
* Build and enhance microservices, REST APIs, event-driven services, and backend modules for trading workflows.
* Work on trading platform integrations, liquidity management systems, price feeds, risk engines, execution services, and internal backend tools.
* Apply modern architecture practices such as domain-driven design, CQRS, event-driven architecture, and event sourcing where relevant.
* Work with Vaadin framework for internal UI and console development where required.
* Understand and contribute to mixed Java/Kotlin environments where applicable.
* Collaborate with mobile teams and understand API integration requirements for iOS Swift and Android/Kotlin applications.
* Ensure backend services are reliable, scalable, secure, and aligned with platform requirements.

**4. System Performance, Stability & Reliability**

* Build and maintain low-latency, high-availability backend components.
* Optimize system performance through concurrency tuning, JVM tuning, GC optimization, and efficient service design.
* Support performance testing, load testing, and production-readiness activities.
* Lead or support incident investigation, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Ensure production issues are properly analyzed, documented, and followed up with preventive actions.
* Collaborate with DevOps, Cloud, QA, and monitoring teams to improve system reliability.
* Promote a strong engineering culture around stability, observability, and operational excellence.

**5. Delivery & Project Ownership**

* Drive technical delivery across sprint planning, task breakdown, execution, and release readiness.
* Work closely with Product Owners and Product Managers to understand requirements, clarify scope, and define realistic delivery timelines.
* Challenge unclear requirements, incomplete analysis, or unrealistic timelines where needed.
* Ensure technical dependencies, risks, and blockers are identified early and communicated clearly.
* Track delivery progress and make sure the team is moving according to agreed priorities.
* Ensure releases are delivered with the required quality, documentation, testing support, and technical sign-off.
* Maintain clear communication with Product, QA, DevOps, and management regarding status, risks, and delivery expectations.
* Take ownership of delivery outcomes, not only technical implementation.

**6. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Work closely with QA and QA Automation teams to support testing, integration testing, regression testing, and load testing.
* Collaborate with DevOps and Cloud teams on deployments, CI/CD pipelines, environments, monitoring, and infrastructure needs.
* Coordinate with Mobile teams to ensure backend APIs and services meet mobile application requirements.
* Work with Trading, Risk, Dealing, Compliance, and Operations teams where business or system knowledge is required.
* Ensure technical communication between teams is clear, structured, and action-oriented.

**7. Engineering Standards & Process Improvement**

* Enforce coding standards, code review practices, documentation, and technical governance.
* Improve development processes, estimation accuracy, release readiness, and operational efficiency.
* Identify recurring issues within the team and propose practical improvements.
* Support the adoption of automation, AI tools, and engineering productivity improvements.
* Encourage the team to use modern tools and practices to increase speed, quality, and maintainability.
* Ensure the team follows agreed engineering, security, and release processes.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 7+ years of backend engineering experience, with strong hands-on Java development.
* Strong experience with Java 17+ and modern backend development practices.
* Proven experience (2+ years) of leading a technical team (7+ members) as a team or technical lead.
* Experience managing team delivery, task breakdown, estimation, technical planning, and execution.
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
* Experience designing and developing REST APIs and backend integrations.
* Experience with event-driven systems, messaging, and asynchronous processing.
* Strong understanding of system performance, scalability, reliability, and production support.
* Experience with cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Experience working with DevOps teams on CI/CD, deployments, and environment management.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead with ownership, accountability, and minimal supervision.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to make decisions under pressure.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in Forex, CFD, Fintech, Trading, Banking, or financial systems.
* Experience with trading platform integrations, liquidity providers, price feeds, execution systems, or risk engines.
* Knowledge of FIX Protocol and FIX Market Data.
* Experience with price feed aggregation engines.
* Experience with Vaadin framework.
* Knowledge of Kotlin and mixed Java/Kotlin environments.
* Understanding of mobile trading app architecture and backend API requirements for Swift/Kotlin applications.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, or similar.
* Exposure to financial regulations such as FSA, DFSA, CySEC, FCA, ASIC, or similar.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or cloud-native architecture.
* Experience using AI tools to improve development productivity, code quality, documentation, and delivery efficiency.

title: Business Project Coordinator, Senior Associate
description:

Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As an Executive Business Partner within Vanguard India, you will provide high-impact support to the India Site Head and partner closely with senior leaders across the organisation. You will play a critical role in ensuring executive priorities are effectively managed and strategic initiatives are successfully coordinated and executed.
  
  
The role requires balancing executive operations, business planning activities, leadership communications, project coordination, and site engagement initiatives. You will serve as a central point of coordination across leaders, teams, and stakeholders, ensuring alignment, visibility, and execution against key business objectives.

title: Principal Engineering Manager
description:
**Overview**
As a Principal Engineering Manager on the GitHub Developer Experience (DX) team, you will lead a team responsible for foundational systems and services that power GitHub’s internal engineering and development workflows. DX focuses on improving how GitHub engineering teams build, test, and ship software across the company—operating at significant scale and complexity. Our work spans CI/CD platforms, developer tooling, virtualized infrastructure, and the paved paths that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining reliability and security.
  
  
We provide the tooling, services, and operational support that allow engineers to deliver changes to production safely and efficiently. This includes running highly available, company-wide CI platforms; partnering closely with application and platform teams to improve reliability and performance; and continuously reducing friction in the developer workflow. The team plays a critical role in maintaining trust in GitHub’s build and test infrastructure while balancing speed, scale, and stability.
  
  
GitHub’s continued growth brings both opportunity and complexity. As a Principal Engineering Manager in this role, you will lead a team operating mission-critical systems in a fast-moving environment. You’ll work closely with engineers across the company to improve CI reliability, reduce test flakiness, respond to incidents, and evolve our platforms to meet the needs of a rapidly scaling organization. This role blends people leadership, technical depth, and operational ownership, with a direct impact on the daily experience of GitHub engineers and the quality of the products used by millions of developers worldwide.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Our team is distributed worldwide, which means we work both asynchronously and real-time. Your typical week would include:
  
  

* Collaborating with engineering teams, product management, customers, and engineering leadership to align on and understand the problems we want to solve
* Unblocking obstacles for your team members as they solve GitHub’s most critical problems, often via real-time conversations in Slack or Zoom and with asynchronous communication in GitHub Issues, PRs, Discussions, and Projects
* Communicating effectively to stakeholders and leadership of progress and risks
* Coordinating work within the team and stakeholders, building relationships, and identifying opportunities and areas of improvement
* Ensuring the team produces good architectural design outcomes, secure and resilient systems, and quality code
* Ensuring the team iteratively ships features and bug fixes, balancing speed to market with future velocity
* Conducting 1:1s with direct reports to provide regular feedback and ensure career growth and progression

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications:
  
  

* 9+ years' experience in software engineering, computer science, or related technical discipline
* Proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, Go, Ruby, Rust, Python, JavaScript, C, C++, C#, Java,
* 3+ years’ experience leading engineering teams delivering complex infrastructure, platform, release, or validation systems.
* Experience setting technical direction and driving execution across multiple engineers or teams in a complex cross-functional environment.
* Proven ability to hire, coach, and develop engineers while maintaining high standards for technical quality and operational excellence.
* Proven ability to partner across organizations, align stakeholders, and improve reliability, delivery predictability, and engineering effectiveness for business-critical systems.
* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, or related field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading or owning large-scale CI/CD and build systems, including monolith or monorepo environments, with a focus on reliability, performance, and developer experience.
* Proven ability to run operationally critical platforms, including incident response, on-call leadership, observability, and cross-org escalation.
* Track record of cross-team collaboration and influence, working with application owners and platform teams to drive best practices and paved paths.
* Familiarity with test infrastructure and quality challenges at scale, including diagnosing CI failures and reducing flaky tests.
* Experienced people manager able to balance execution, operational stability, and long-term platform investment in complex, high-change environments.
* Experience driving strategy and execution across multiple dependent engineering teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Passionate about fostering good engineering practices and processes
* Experience recruiting and retaining healthy teams, managing performance, and calibrating expectations
* Experience working remotely and collaborating with distributed teams.

title: Lead Scrum Master
description:
**About This Role**
Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Scrum Master.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Manage and develop Scaled Agile portfolios of the highest complexity
* Guide the teams to follow Agile and Scrum practices to promote prioritization, team readiness, and commitment for each Sprint
* Optimize scrum team velocity to identify improvement opportunities to achieve higher levels of team performance
* Oversee systemic impediments to team agility and guide the teams on methods to escalate
* Deliver capabilities using agile practices while following the Software Development Lifecycle, business process mapping, and various release processes to ensure all risk, security, and development requirements are met
* Partner with discipline managers to convey their concerns to scrum teams about governance policies and adherence to corporate standards
* Collaborate with product owners, program or project managers to communicate delivery of work product from the teams and escalate key risks and issues impeding scrum team effectiveness
* Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals
* Interact with internal customers
* Receive direction from leaders and exercise independent judgment while developing the knowledge to understand function, policies, procedures, and compliance requirements
* Train other Scrum Masters and serve as a mentor to less experienced staff

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Agile Scrum Master experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* Agile Scrum Master experience in large-scale Agile and Scaled Agile (SAFe) environments.
* Proven experience building, coaching, and maturing high-performing, self-organizing, and highly accountable engineering teams.
* Experience supporting teams developing modern cloud-native applications, distributed systems, microservices, and enterprise Java platforms.
* Exposure to AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, or intelligent automation initiatives within product delivery organizations.
* Strong understanding of engineering excellence practices including CI/CD, DevSecOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), observability, automation, and platform engineering.
* Demonstrated ability to drive Agile transformation, organizational change, and continuous improvement across multiple teams and portfolios.
* Experience partnering with Engineering Managers, Architects, Product Managers, and Technical Leads to improve delivery predictability, quality, and operational excellence.

* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, innovation, quality, and operational ownership.

This role will be responsible for both helping build and launch new products and enhancements, as well as maintaining, supporting, and continuously improving existing AI, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and automation products after go-live.
  
  
This is a versatile, hands-on role suited for someone who can wear many hats across business analysis, product support, roadmap planning, low-code/no-code automation, AI solution enablement, documentation, testing, release support, and operational maintenance. The role is especially well suited for a technically minded analyst or engineer who enjoys client-facing work, thrives in ambiguity, takes initiative, and wants to help a small team deliver high-value technology outcomes.

* Partner with RDO leaders, business stakeholders, product owners, architects, engineers, and vendors to understand business objectives and translate them into actionable technology roadmap items, features, user stories, and requirements.

* Support proofs of concept, pilots, and experiments for AI, automation, and collaboration solutions, including success criteria, risk considerations, stakeholder feedback, and transition-to-production planning.
* Use internal AI capabilities and approved tools to improve productivity, summarize information, support analysis, develop drafts, and identify opportunities for process automation.
* Support responsible AI practices by helping document business purpose, expected outcomes, risks, controls, human review points, and adoption considerations for AI-enabled solutions.
* Perform initial triage, troubleshooting, and support coordination for product issues, data questions, access requests, workflow failures, and user feedback.
* Coordinate small enhancements and maintenance activities across a lean team of approximately three resources, flexing between build, run, analysis, testing, documentation, and stakeholder support as needed.
* Prepare and deliver product demonstrations, training materials, walkthroughs, and stakeholder updates for business and technology audiences.

* 4+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, technology analysis, product analysis, digital solutions, information systems, engineering, or a related technology delivery role.

**Functional Skills**
**Must-Have Skills**

**Role Statement**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Performance & Quality Senior Analyst ensures work is efficiently prioritized, planned, and delivered across the ERP Tech Factory (ERP Core Customization, Custom Application Development & APEX, ERP Operational Reporting, and Test Automation Factory).
  
  
The role owns intake demand management and capacity planning—ensuring requests are transparently prioritized, sized, and allocated against available capacity in a predictable cadence. In parallel, the Analyst drives process standardization, quality assurance, and continuous improvement, embedding repeatable practices and quality checkpoints across the full delivery lifecycle.
  
  
As a member of the Tech Factory Lead's staff, the role provides executive visibility into throughput, performance, and quality trends—enabling data-driven decisions on prioritization, resourcing, and delivery optimization.
  
  
**Key Duties**
**Intake Demand Management**

* Own and manage the intake process for new requests (enhancements, fixes, test, reporting needs) across the four Tech Factory pods.
* Define and maintain intake criteria, templates, and qualification checkpoints to ensure completeness and readiness of incoming demand.
* Oversee and ensure that requests are triaged and routed to the appropriate pillar/team based on scope, complexity, and priority.
* Maintain a consolidated demand backlog, ensuring visibility and traceability from intake to delivery.

**Capacity Planning & Resource Allocation**

* Build and maintain capacity planning across ERP core customization, Custom application development & APEX, ERP Operating Reporting and Test Automation Factory Pods.
* Monitor team utilization and forecast capacity against incoming demand, flagging bottlenecks or over/under-allocation.
* Support the Tech Factory Lead in balancing internal vs external resources and in sequencing the delivery roadmap.
* Provide scenario planning (what-if analysis) to support prioritization decisions during planning cycles.

**Process Standardization & Repeatability**

* Design, document, and maintain standardized workflows and delivery processes across the Tech Factory to ensure consistency and repeatability.
* Identify variability and inefficiencies in current processes, proposing streamlined, repeatable alternatives.
* Define and roll out quality checkpoints/gates across the delivery lifecycle (design, build, test, release), in alignment with the Tech Factory Lead.

Performance & Quality Monitoring
  
  

* Define, track, and report key performance and quality metrics across the Tech Factory (e.g. throughput, cycle time, delivery predictability, defect rates, and conversion of requests to delivery).
* Analyze trends and patterns to identify systemic issues, recurring bottlenecks, or quality risks.[NS1.1]
* Produce regular dashboards/reports for the Tech Factory Lead and stakeholders, highlighting performance against targets.

**Continuous Improvement & Governance**

* Recommend continuous improvement initiatives based on data insights, for review and validation by the Tech Factory Lead.
* Partner with Tech Factory Pods to embed best practices and process discipline.
* Maintain process documentation, playbooks, and knowledge assets to support onboarding and consistency across teams.
* Support governance activities by preparing structured inputs and materials for the Weekly Tech Operations Sync, Release & Technical Alignment meetings, and Monthly Platform Review
* Promote a culture of predictability, transparency, and continuous improvement within the Tech Factory, under the guidance of the Tech Factory Lead.

**Required**
**Qualification and Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in a demand/capacity planning, process improvement, PMO, or business/process analyst role, ideally within an IT or ERP delivery environment.
* Proven experience designing and managing intake processes and capacity planning frameworks.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate operational data into actionable insights.
* Experience defining and tracking performance/quality KPIs and building reporting dashboards.
* Experience in software/ERP delivery lifecycles (development, testing, release management).
* Strong process-orientation, structured problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience working in Follow-the-Sun or shift-based global support models.

* Experience with planning/reporting tools (e.g. ServiceNow, Power BI, or similar).
* Familiarity with ITIL-aligned incident management frameworks and tools (ServiceNow).
* Background in ERP support environments within manufacturing or industrial organizations.
* Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies.

* Intake-to-delivery cycle time

* Delivery predictability rate (planned vs. actual delivery dates)
* Process adherence/compliance rate across the Tech Factory
* Reduction in process variability/rework rate

Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

* High-Performance Culture
* Customer Focus
* Operational Excellence
* Innovation
* Financial Strength

* Own it

* Foster a customer-first mindset

R&D Product Development
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
R&D Software/Systems Engineering
  
  
**Job Category**
Scientific/Technology
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, India
  
  
**Job Description**
**At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything.**
Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity.
  
  
**Sub Function**
Forward Deployed Engineering, Full Stack Product Engineering, Digital Solutions & Cloud Applications
  
  
**Location**
Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**Reports To**
Director, Product Engineering / ICC
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
Johnson & Johnson is seeking a highly capable Forward Deployed Engineer, Full Stack, Lead Engineer to work directly with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering partners to design, build, deploy, and operationalize modern digital solutions in real-world enterprise environments.
  
  
This role will serve as a hands-on technical lead embedded close to users and product teams, translating ambiguous business problems into secure, scalable, and production-ready full stack solutions. The successful candidate will bridge product strategy, solution architecture, engineering execution, deployment, adoption, and operational support across Clinical Development, R&D, Medical Affairs, and enterprise technology capabilities.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep full stack engineering expertise, strong systems thinking, customer-facing problem solving, cloud-native delivery experience, DevSecOps discipline, and the ability to rapidly prototype, harden, and scale solutions within regulated enterprise technology environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Forward Deployed Engineering Leadership
  
  

* Act as the technical lead for customer-embedded delivery efforts, owning solution discovery, design, build, deployment, and adoption from concept to production.
* Lead by influence across product managers, architects, engineers, data teams, AI teams, cybersecurity, quality, and business stakeholders.
* Translate complex and evolving business needs into actionable technical designs, prototypes, integration patterns, and delivery plans.
* Mentor engineers on solution design, secure coding, debugging, technical decision-making, and production-readiness practices.

Full Stack Product Engineering
  
  

* Design and build modern web applications, APIs, services, workflow tools, dashboards, portals, automation components, and integration layers.
* Rapidly prototype solutions with users, validate value, iterate based on feedback, and convert prototypes into maintainable production-grade applications.
* Own implementation across front-end, back-end, API, database, identity, integration, observability, and deployment layers.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, accessible, performant, compliant, and aligned with enterprise architecture and platform standards.

Deployment, Integration & Enterprise Platforms
  
  

* Deploy and integrate solutions within complex enterprise environments, including legacy systems, cloud platforms, identity services, data platforms, and third-party applications.
* Apply cloud-native patterns, microservices, API-first design, event-driven integration, containerization, and managed services where appropriate.
* Troubleshoot production issues, resolve integration blockers, optimize performance, and address edge cases in live business workflows.
* Capture deployment learnings and convert them into reusable engineering patterns, product improvements, accelerators, and reference architectures.

DevSecOps & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, quality gates, security scans, infrastructure automation, and release management practices.
* Establish operational KPIs covering reliability, performance, deployment frequency, incident trends, and service health.
* Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, and quality teams to ensure secure software development lifecycle practices.
* Drive root cause analysis, technical debt reduction, application rationalization, and continuous platform improvement.

Stakeholder & Product Delivery
  
  

* Run discovery workshops, technical deep dives, and solution design sessions with business users, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Communicate trade-offs, risks, technical options, and delivery progress clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Partner with product teams to convert field insights into backlog items, platform enhancements, roadmap inputs, and adoption strategies.
* Balance rapid delivery, business value, user adoption, security, compliance, quality, and long-term maintainability.

Compliance, Security & Quality
  
  

* Ensure applications comply with applicable enterprise security, privacy, quality, accessibility, and regulatory requirements.
* Support delivery practices aligned with GxP, Computer System Validation (CSV), GDPR, HIPAA, and internal J&J technology standards where applicable.
* Maintain audit-ready engineering documentation, traceability, and release evidence for regulated applications.
* Promote responsible use of data and AI-enabled capabilities within application experiences.

**Required Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Master's Degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in software engineering, full stack development, enterprise application delivery, solution engineering, or digital product engineering.
* 3+ years of experience as a technical lead, lead engineer, solution architect, forward deployed engineer, or senior hands-on engineering owner.
* Proven experience building and deploying production-grade full stack applications using modern front-end, back-end, API, database, and cloud technologies.
* Experience working directly with business users or customers to discover needs, design solutions, implement integrations, troubleshoot issues, and drive adoption.
* Experience with Agile delivery, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, release management, and production support practices.
* Experience in Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or other regulated industries preferred.

With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we foster a startup mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution\-driven attitude. **Position Details**

* Function/Department: Infrastructure

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Scrum Master to lead and support a ServiceNow development squad. You will be the driving force behind Agile delivery — ensuring the team understands business requirements, commits to well\-defined sprint goals, and consistently clears the backlog with quality outcomes. This role requires someone who can bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical developers, translating complex ServiceNow deliverables into actionable Epics, Stories, and Tasks.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Agile Delivery
   

  

* Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies — Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement
* Own the sprint cadence and ensure the team maintains a predictable, healthy velocity
* Drive backlog grooming sessions to ensure Stories are well\-defined, estimated, and prioritized before entering a sprint
* Monitor and actively clear sprint blockers, escalating where necessary to keep delivery on track
* Track and report sprint progress, burn\-down, and velocity metrics to stakeholders


 Backlog \& Requirements Management
   

  

* Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to break down business needs into well\-structured Epics, Features, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria
* Ensure the development team fully understands requirements before committing to sprint work — no ambiguous Stories enter the sprint
* Maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog at all times with sufficient runway ahead of sprints
* Challenge vague or incomplete requirements and advocate for Definition of Ready (DoR) before work begins


 ServiceNow Squad Support
   

  

* Develop sufficient understanding of ServiceNow modules and development concepts (ITSM, workflows, integrations, configurations) to meaningfully participate in technical discussions and call out risks
* Identify dependencies across platform teams, environments, and releases that could impact sprint commitments
* Coordinate with ServiceNow architects and developers on release planning, update set management, and environment availability


 Team Leadership \& Influence
   

  

* Act as a servant leader — coaching the team on Agile principles and holding them accountable without micromanaging
* Influence and enforce Agile best practices across the squad, including proper Story sizing, DoR/DoD adherence, and continuous improvement
* Protect the team from scope creep and unplanned work mid\-sprint
* Foster a culture of ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement through regular retrospectives with actionable follow\-through


 JIRA Administration
   

  

* Maintain JIRA as the single source of truth — ensuring all Epics, Stories, Tasks, and Bugs are accurately created, updated, and closed in a timely manner
* Configure and manage JIRA boards, workflows, and sprint structures for the squad
* Generate and present JIRA\-based reports — velocity charts, cumulative flow diagrams, sprint reports to leadership and stakeholders
* Enforce team discipline around JIRA hygiene: status updates, story point entries, and linking of dependencies


**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* 6\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, with at least 2 years supporting a technical development squad
* Deep understanding of Agile frameworks — Scrum, Kanban, SAFe — and hands\-on experience running all Scrum ceremonies
* Proven ability to write and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear Acceptance Criteria
* Strong JIRA proficiency — board configuration, backlog management, reporting, and sprint administration
* Experience working with or alongside ServiceNow development teams (direct platform development experience is a plus, not a requirement)
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM I/II)
* Strong stakeholder management — comfortable influencing at all levels, from developers to senior leadership


**Preferred Qualifications**
* SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) or SAFe Agilist (SA) certification
* Experience in regulated industries (financial services, insurance, healthcare)
* Familiarity with ITIL and ServiceNow ITSM concepts
* Experience with PI Planning and Program Increment coordination
* Knowedge of DevOps practices — CI/CD, release management, environment coordination

* Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results

* Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

 Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well\-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. * Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.

**Position Overview**

 Role Title: Technical Program Manager – Full Stack, Cloud \& AI Engineering

 Experience Required: Minimum 14\+ years of experience

 **Technical Program Manager** 
 to lead and manage multiple cross\-functional engineering pod teams based in Hyderabad.
