 The ideal candidate should have prior experience managing complex technology programs involving distributed engineering teams, product owners, architects, developers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders. The candidate must be comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels — driving roadmap alignment, technical delivery, architecture discussions, release governance, dependency management, risk mitigation, and executive\-level reporting.
   

  

 This is not a pure project management role. The candidate is expected to bring strong technical judgment, understand engineering trade\-offs, challenge solution approaches where required, and guide teams toward scalable, secure, maintainable, and AI\-enabled delivery practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program \& Delivery Leadership**
* Lead multiple engineering pod teams delivering full stack, cloud\-native, and enterprise\-grade digital applications.
* Own end\-to\-end program execution across planning, design, development, testing, release, deployment, and production support.
* Drive delivery predictability across multiple pods by managing scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, milestones, and release commitments.
* Partner with product owners, architects, engineering managers, QA leads, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure successful execution.
* Establish clear operating rhythms across sprint planning, backlog refinement, architecture reviews, dependency tracking, release planning, and production readiness.
* Monitor execution health across pods and proactively address blockers, capacity gaps, technical risks, and cross\-team dependencies.
* Drive alignment between business objectives, product priorities, technical architecture, and delivery execution.
* Ensure programs are delivered with strong focus on quality, security, scalability, maintainability, and operational stability.


**Technical Program Management**
* Facilitate technical design discussions across .NET Core, Angular, REST APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, databases, DevSecOps, and integration platforms.
* Partner with architects and senior engineers to validate solution approaches, identify architectural risks, and ensure adherence to enterprise standards.
* Drive technical governance across application architecture, API design, cloud integration, security, performance, observability, and deployment practices.
* Ensure engineering teams follow clean architecture, SOLID principles, secure coding practices, CI/CD standards, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Track and manage technical debt, platform modernization initiatives, production stability issues, and engineering improvement plans.
* Support teams in resolving production issues related to performance, scalability, reliability, integrations, cloud services, and deployment pipelines.
* Ensure delivery teams adopt appropriate engineering metrics, including sprint predictability, defect leakage, deployment frequency, change failure rate, code quality, test coverage, and production incident trends.


**AI \& Gen AI Enablement**
* Drive responsible adoption of AI and Gen AI tools across engineering pods to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, testing, and problem\-solving.
* Enable teams to use platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or similar enterprise\-approved AI platforms.
* Identify practical AI use cases across software delivery, including code generation, refactoring, unit test generation, API documentation, technical design documentation, defect analysis, and security review support.
* Establish AI usage guardrails aligned with enterprise security, data privacy, compliance, intellectual property, and responsible AI policies.
* Partner with engineering and security teams to evaluate AI\-assisted development workflows and ensure safe adoption.
* Track productivity and quality improvements resulting from AI\-enabled engineering practices.
* Promote a culture of AI\-assisted engineering while ensuring human accountability for design, code quality, security, and production outcomes.


**Agile, DevSecOps \& Release Governance**
* Lead agile execution across multiple pods using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models.
* Drive consistent sprint ceremonies, backlog hygiene, estimation practices, release planning, and execution governance.
* Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, quality gates, code reviews, test automation, security scans, and release approvals are integrated into delivery workflows.
* Partner with DevOps and platform teams to improve deployment reliability, environment stability, monitoring, logging, and incident response.
* Ensure production releases meet defined entry and exit criteria, including quality, security, performance, and operational readiness checks.
* Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, agile maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and delivery effectiveness.


**Stakeholder \& Executive Communication**
* Provide clear, concise, and data\-driven program updates to senior leadership, including Directors, VPs, and CXO\-level stakeholders where required.
* Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, financial impacts, delivery trade\-offs, and mitigation plans with appropriate executive clarity.
* Prepare roadmap views, release dashboards, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and program health reports.
* Translate complex technical topics into business\-relevant insights for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Drive decision\-making across competing priorities, delivery constraints, architecture options, and risk scenarios.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Minimum 14\+ years of overall technology experience, with strong background in software engineering, technical delivery, program management, or engineering leadership.
* Proven experience managing multiple engineering pods or cross\-functional agile teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong technical understanding of full stack application delivery using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, Angular, C\#, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, backend services, cloud\-native application patterns, and scalable web architectures.
* Experience working with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* Good understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, identity management, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, Git\-based workflows, automated deployment, and production release governance.
* Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with event\-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Practical experience using AI or Gen AI platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of agile delivery models, sprint execution, roadmap planning, dependency management, and engineering metrics.
* Ability to challenge technical assumptions, identify delivery risks, and drive resolution across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, security, and business teams.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to engage senior leadership and technical teams with equal effectiveness.


**Preferred Technical Capabilities**
* Prior hands\-on software engineering experience before moving into technical program management or engineering leadership.
* Experience managing enterprise\-scale modernization, cloud migration, platform transformation, or digital product engineering programs.
* Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, insurance, life sciences, or other compliance\-heavy environments.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture governance, security reviews, audit requirements, and compliance controls.
* Experience with observability platforms, production support models, SRE practices, and incident management.
* Experience implementing AI\-assisted SDLC practices across large engineering teams.
* Understanding of responsible AI, AI governance, data privacy, secure prompt usage, and enterprise AI adoption frameworks.


**AI Platform Expectations**
 The candidate should be hands\-on and comfortable using AI platforms to:
   

  

* Improve engineering productivity across multiple pod teams.
* Assist with code review, code generation, and refactoring analysis.
* Generate unit test cases and improve test coverage.
* Support API documentation, architecture documentation, and technical design documentation.
* Analyze technical designs, logs, defects, and production issues for faster triage.
* Identify security, performance, and maintainability concerns in application delivery.
* Build reusable AI\-enabled workflows for engineering teams.
* Promote responsible AI adoption in alignment with enterprise policies.
* Ensure AI tools are used as productivity accelerators while preserving engineering accountability, security, and compliance.


**Leadership \& Soft Skills**
* Strong ownership mindset with ability to operate independently in a senior leadership\-facing role.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to lead multiple teams through ambiguity, changing priorities, and complex dependencies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to balance delivery speed with technical quality, security, scalability, and maintainability.
* Strong communication skills with ability to simplify complex technical issues for executive audiences.
* Ability to mentor pod leads, scrum masters, technical leads, and engineering teams on delivery discipline and engineering best practices.
* Strong execution discipline with focus on measurable outcomes, delivery transparency, and continuous improvement.


**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.

description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Delivery Management Professional leads moderately complex deliveries, proactively identifies improvements, manages diverse stakeholders, and contributes to strategic implementation. In this role, you will independently define and control the scope of medium to large initiatives, utilizing effective facilitation and analytical skills to drive value delivery. While navigating intricate stakeholder environments, you will connect team development with broader business objectives. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Project Manager, Service (Delivery) Manager, ITSM Process SME, Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach.
   

  

**Description Of The Area**
 This team is responsible for delivering software systems for the data acquisition and processing of Roche clinical trial data, serving as the source of truth across Roche Pharma. Foundational systems in this area include Roche’s electronic data capture (EDC) \- Medidata Rave, non\-CRF systems including biomarker and sample metadata ingestion, and clinical data warehouses.
   

  

 These systems are critical to drug development, powering clinical data review, safety reporting, operational insights for clinical teams, and support early development activities in the REDs. They provide data to the Analytical Data Science’s ecosystems to standardize and analyze data for regulatory submissions. In addition, standardized clinical data from these systems are essential to integrate with Roche’s specialized data modality platforms including omics, clinical imaging, and digital health technologies.
   

  

 A key focus in this area will be to leverage emerging AI technologies to optimize clinical data acquisition data pipelines. This includes enriching metadata and building AI\-ready datasets to enable autonomous agentic and human\-in\-the loop AI systems which are transforming the drug development process.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently defines, manages, and controls the scope of medium to large initiatives or significant workstreams with moderate complexity. * Impact/Strategy: Demonstrates consistent performance with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster. Contributes to achieving product or domain goals by ensuring value delivery, takes a proactive role in shaping team processes, and contributes to the implementation of strategic objectives for Informatics and the business
* Complexity / (Product Size): Manages moderately complex initiatives or workstreams extending across a product or service. Manages the delivery of complex features, services, or projects (e.g., a service transition, a product release, or an Agile Release Train (ART) increment). Selects and tailors’ delivery methodologies while managing dependencies between activities
* Business/Technical ability: Demonstrates strong business acumen by analyzing business needs and translating them into effective delivery strategies. Selects and adapts delivery methodologies to optimize results, manages complex delivery processes, and utilizes advanced delivery tools and techniques to address business challenges and contribute to planning
* In collaboration with Product and team leads ensure releases and changes are delivered in a controlled and agile manner
* Responsible for driving continuous improvements to elevate overall service experience


**Qualifications**
**Education / Experience**
* Bachelor's / Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Life Sciences, or related technical field. Having professional certifications is an advantage
* Minimum 5\-8 Years experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry
* Proven track record operating in a Delivery Management archetype (e.g., Project Manager, Service Manager, Scrum Master, RTE, Agile Coach) managing medium to large initiatives or significant workstreams
* Experience managing the delivery of complex features or projects (such as service transitions or ART increments) across functional areas
* Demonstrated experience translating requirements into strategic implementation plans and contributing to business planning and forecasting


**Technical Skills**
* Strong ability to select, adapt, and apply appropriate delivery methodologies to optimize results
* Proficiency in utilizing advanced delivery tools and techniques to manage complex processes and dependencies
* Strong analytical skills to drive root cause analysis and propose comprehensive improvement plans
* In depth knowledge of GxP regulated environments and computer systems validation


**Additional Qualifications**
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to facilitate workshops, resolve conflicts, and act as a trusted advisor to diverse stakeholders
* Strong coaching and mentoring mindset, capable of championing accountability, connecting team development with business objectives, and building team spirit
* Flexibility: Ability to adapt to shifting priorities and commit to collaboration with team members globally

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. **Role Overview**
 The AI Ops Application Operations Lead owns the production lifecycle of agentic coding applications, plugins, and skills across Zeta. The role helps teams move high\-value prototypes into production and keeps applications reliable, useful, governed, and measurable after launch.
   

  

 This role partners closely with application owners, AI Operations, IT, Security, and other technical teams. Its primary focus is production readiness, lifecycle and release management, feedback loops, and clear visibility into adoption, performance, and business impact.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines application operations, technical program management, and product fluency. They do not need to be the primary developer for every application, but they must be comfortable working with AI\-assisted development tools, understanding application architecture, translating business needs into technical requirements, and coordinating work across stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Production Readiness and Launch**
* Partner with owners of agenticly coded applications to assess whether an application is ready to move from prototype to production.
* Establish and manage a consistent production\-readiness process covering security, privacy, data access, architecture, user experience, support, monitoring, and documentation.
* Identify launch risks, dependencies, and gaps, and coordinate the work required to address them.
* Connect application owners with IT, Security, Data, Legal, and other teams involved in production approval and deployment.
* Develop launch plans, readiness checklists, support models, and ownership documentation for each application.
* Ensure applications have clear business objectives, target users, success measures, and accountable owners before launch.


**Application Operations and Lifecycle Management**
* Manage the ongoing operational health of production applications.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of fixes, enhancements, and technical improvements based on direction from the application owner.
* Coordinate application updates, testing, release management, and communication to users.
* Help ensure applications remain compatible with changes to models, APIs, enterprise systems, data sources, and security requirements.
* Establish clear escalation paths for defects, incidents, access issues, and performance concerns.
* Maintain accurate documentation for application functionality, dependencies, ownership, and support procedures.


**Feedback, Adoption, and Continuous Improvement**
* Help application owners establish structured feedback loops with users.
* Collect and organize user feedback, feature requests, defects, and usage insights.
* Translate feedback into clear product requirements and backlog items.
* Support application owners in prioritizing improvements based on user value, business impact, risk, and effort.
* Coordinate user testing and validation before major releases.
* Identify common patterns across applications that could inform shared standards, reusable components, or broader AI Ops priorities.


**Measurement and Analytics**
* Develop and maintain dashboards that provide application owners with visibility into adoption, usage, reliability, performance, and business outcomes.
* Define appropriate metrics for each application, including active users, usage frequency, task completion, response quality, errors, latency, user satisfaction, and estimated time or cost savings.
* Monitor application health and surface risks, adoption gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with application owners to review performance regularly and agree on actions.
* Help determine whether applications should be expanded, redesigned, consolidated, or retired based on evidence.


**Governance, Standards, and Portfolio Management**
* Apply AI Ops standards for application development, production readiness, responsible AI, security, documentation, and measurement.
* Help create reusable templates, checklists, playbooks, and operating procedures for agentic coding applications.
* Support the development of a governed application portfolio and inventory.
* Ensure applications have clear ownership, approved data access, defined user groups, and appropriate controls.
* Promote consistency across applications while allowing teams to move quickly and iterate.


**Key Outcomes**
**Success In This Role Will Be Measured By**
* Increased percentage of high\-value prototypes successfully moved into production.
* Reduced time from prototype completion to production launch.
* Stronger production readiness and fewer post\-launch issues.
* Clear ownership and support models for every production application.
* Consistent visibility into application adoption, reliability, and business impact.
* Faster response to user feedback and application issues.
* Increased adoption and sustained usage of production applications.
* A well\-managed portfolio of applications aligned to business priorities and enterprise standards.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Experience in application operations, technical program management, product operations, product management, or a closely related role.
* Strong ability to coordinate work across business, product, engineering, IT, security, and data teams.
* Experience taking internal digital products, AI applications, or technology solutions from prototype through production launch.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical and operational requirements.
* Strong backlog management, prioritization, documentation, and release management skills.
* Experience defining product metrics and building or managing performance dashboards.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort working in a fast\-moving environment with evolving tools, standards, and priorities


**Preferred**
* Experience with AI\-assisted software development, low\-code tools, or agentic coding platforms.
* Familiarity with modern AI models, APIs, agents, workflow automation, and application architectures.
* Experience working with enterprise security, privacy, identity, access management, and software governance processes.
* Familiarity with analytics tools, application monitoring, user telemetry, and experimentation.
* Experience supporting internal enterprise applications or employee productivity tools.
* Working knowledge of software development practices, including testing, deployment, version control, and incident management.


**Core Capabilities**

* Technical program management
* Stakeholder coordination
* Production readiness

* Application analytics and measurement
* Risk and dependency management

 This role is well suited for someone who enjoys turning early\-stage prototypes into dependable, scalable applications. They are comfortable operating between business and technology teams, creating structure where processes are still developing, and helping application owners make decisions based on user feedback and performance data.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be practical, organized, technically curious, and focused on measurable outcomes. They will know when to move quickly, when to slow down to address risk, and how to keep application owners and technical teams aligned throughout the application lifecycle.

description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
   

  

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
   

  

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high\-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 In this role, you will ensure the quality, reliability, and integrity of DTCC’s Enterprise Architecture Platform (EAP) as it evolves from MVP to enterprise\-scale deployment. You will lead day\-to\-day testing and release readiness activities across platform enhancements, integrations, and reporting layers, helping teams deliver stable capabilities with measurable business value. Your work will strengthen confidence in the EAP platform data and insights, reduce release risk, and support consistent adoption across architecture, business, and technology teams
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
* Define and execute the test strategy for EAP releases across self data configuration changes, integrations, and EA Insights (Power BI) reporting layers.
* Lead test planning, test case design, test execution, and defect management to ensure high\-quality delivery of platform enhancements and dashboards.
* Validate data accuracy and traceability from self source data through integration pipelines to insights dashboards; partner with stakeholders to resolve data defects.
* Support UAT coordination with Business Architecture and other stakeholders, including UAT scripts, facilitation, and sign\-off documentation.
* Collaborate with team members to establish testing scripts, test data needs, and release readiness gates (smoke/regression testing).
* Support agile delivery execution by coordinating sprint testing activities, participating in backlog refinement, and ensuring acceptance criteria are testable and met.
* Maintain delivery cadence while balancing new development testing and production stability, including triage of production issues and post\-release validation.
* Report quality metrics and release risks to stakeholders; continuously improve QA processes, templates, and automation opportunities where applicable.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 10 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience
* Effective written and verbal communication for issue reporting


**Talents Needed For Success**
* Experience creating test plans, test cases, and executing functional/regression testing; familiarity with defect lifecycle management.
* Working knowledge of testing concepts for data and reporting solutions (data validation, reconciliation, dashboard verification); Power BI testing experience is a plus.
* Familiarity with tools such as JIRA for defect tracking, intake, and workflow management.
* Strong attention to detail and analytical skills; ability to identify issues, communicate impacts, and drive closure with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to coordinate UAT with stakeholders and ensure results, issues, and sign\-offs are documented.
* Comfortably working in a fast\-paced environment with frequent change, multiple priorities, and enterprise stakeholders.
* Opportunity to lead quality practices for a new enterprise platform, improving release confidence and data reliability as EAP scales across DTCC.
* Hands\-on experience coordinating end\-to\-end testing, UAT, and release readiness for platform capabilities, integrations, and insights.
* Exposure to senior architects, product leaders, engineering teams, and enterprise stakeholders through cross\-functional delivery and adoption initiatives.
* A growth environment with clear development pathways, building skills in quality engineering, data validation, and enterprise\-scale platform delivery.


 Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Digitial Product Management Sr Analyst
description:
**Overview**
 One of PepsiCo’s priorities focus areas in the digital strategy is Sales Effectives. Sales Effectiveness (SE) exists to improve front line performance of daily tasks, increasing sales through prescriptive recommendations for prospecting, selling, servicing, and merchandising. Within SE, there are several digital products being developed. Within SE, there are several digital products being developed. This position is to support Product AiQ and BluePrint. Account IQ will create a common interface for our businesses to drive effectiveness of our Key Account Managers. and BluePrint is an application to enable digital transformation of our AFH Partners. The position of Product Sr. Analyst, AiQ will orchestrate all aspects of product management ranging from supporting the roadmap while also ensuring unified understanding and delivery across teams (architecture, data foundation, service design, operations) and also overseeing the global expansion. This product will serve as the foundational capability and product for our SE transformation to unlock business value via a unified solution.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Product Ownership
   

  

* Serve as a subject matter expert of our current \& planned AiQ \& BluePrint capabilities
* Facilitate meetings with cross\-functional business and technical teams to gather product requirements and business use cases
* Prioritize and create clear user stories and acceptance criteria day\-by\-day and manage progress through agile ceremonies by working with leads, developers, and scrum masters
* Define, create, and manage the product backlog through weekly backlog sessions
* Manage QA by accepting the completed user stories to make sure the work fulfills the criteria
* Provide feedback at demos related to product delivery, usability, and functionality, and escalate any discrepancies to Product Manager to ensure business goals are met
* Outline PI Objectives and lead validation efforts with all stakeholders; co\-lead PI planning
* In partnership with the Scrum Master, identify risks and concerns for product delivery as related to individual teams
* Surface blockers and provide recommended solutions based on trade\-offs to optimize customer experience, and time\-to\-market
* Clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal stakeholders and remote teams
* Update Product Documentation as necessary including technical requirements, roadmaps, feature availability, and metadata management


 Compensation and Benefits:
   

  

* Location, confirmed job\-related skills, experience, and education will be considered in setting actual starting salary. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process.
* Bonus based on performance and eligibility target payout is 8% of annual salary paid out annually.
* Paid time off subject to eligibility, including paid parental leave, vacation, sick, and bereavement.
* In addition to salary, PepsiCo offers a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees and their families, subject to elections and eligibility: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Health, and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Insurance (Accident, Group Legal, Life), Defined Contribution Retirement Plan.


**Qualifications**
* BA or MBA in Business Management or a related field
* 9\+ years of work experience as a Product Analyst / Owner bringing software products to market
* Agile methodology experience from defining user stories, to sizing, Sprint Planning and Sprint Execution to go live and hyper care
* Strong communicator with excellent people skills to interact with various teams inside the company, clients, and vendors.
* Metrics\-driven: strong analytical and synthesis skills (both qualitative \& quantitative), including the ability to absorb and process large amounts of data into actionable information
* Undergraduate degree required, ideally in technical or process focused areas
* Business curiosity via related leadership experience

title: Program Specialist III
description:
**About The Role**
 The Global Support Operations (GSO) Agent Experience (AX) team is responsible for ensuring Uber's customer support agents have the tools, technology, and workflows needed to deliver exceptional customer experiences. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Obsession (CO), GDX, regional Operations, and our global BPO partners to design, test, deploy, and continuously improve agent\-facing products across Uber's global support network.
   

  

 As a
 **GSO AX Program Specialist III** 
 , you will play a key role in shaping how new products and capabilities translate into effective frontline experiences. You will represent the voice of Operations and our support agents throughout the product lifecycle \- from identifying operational problems and defining business requirements, to validating solutions, leading pilots and Hawk tests, enabling global deployments across our BPO network, measuring impact, and driving continuous improvement.
   

  

 This role goes beyond supporting product launches. You will be expected to
 **own Agent Experience outcomes** 
 , influence cross\-functional product decisions, identify opportunities to improve how agents work, and build scalable approaches that enable Uber to deploy technology effectively across a complex, multi\-vendor global support ecosystem.
   

  

 As a Specialist III, you are expected to operate with a high degree of independence \- owning a portfolio of agent\-facing products or workstreams end to end, setting the approach rather than executing a defined one, and raising the bar for how GSO AX partners with Product and BPOs.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong operational judgment with product thinking, has lived the realities of a BPO/contact center environment, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and can influence stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, and our global BPO network.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Identify Agent Experience Opportunities \& Define Requirements**
* Partner with Operations, BPOs, Product, and other stakeholders to identify agent pain points, workflow gaps, and opportunities for technology\-enabled improvements.
* Run structured discovery \- agent shadowing, site visits, BPO listening sessions, tech error and UX issue intake \- to ground requirements in real frontline workflows.
* Translate operational needs into clear business requirements, use cases, and success criteria that Product and Engineering teams can act upon.
* Represent the voice of agents and Operations in product discussions and help ensure solutions are designed with frontline workflows in mind.
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce agent effort and clicks, and improve the overall agent experience.


**Own Product Readiness, Incubation \& UAT**
* Own the operational readiness of new agent\-facing products and features, from early validation through global launch.
* Develop structured UAT, incubation, and pilot approaches that validate functionality against real\-world agent workflows and edge cases.
* Design and run pilots with BPO sites \- defining scope, agent cohorts, training, entry/exit criteria, and issue triage paths.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and BPO teams to identify issues, prioritize improvements, and determine readiness for broader deployment.
* Ensure learnings from pilots and testing translate into actionable product and operational improvements.


**Drive Product Efficacy \& Impact Measurement**
* Define success measures for new tools and capabilities in partnership with Product and Operations stakeholders.
* Lead Hawk testing and other efficacy assessments to understand how products perform in live operational environments, and own the Go/No\-Go recommendation for wider rollout.
* Evaluate the impact of tools on agent experience and operational outcomes across efficiency (AHT, agent effort), quality (QA score, defect/rework rates), customer experience (CSAT, FCR), and adoption/utilization.
* For AI\-enabled capabilities, measure containment/deflection, suggestion acceptance, answer quality, and escalation impact \- and flag quality or trust risks early.
* Build and maintain your own reporting \- pull and analyze data directly (Google Sheets, SQL, Tableau/Looker, or AI\-assisted analysis) rather than depending on analyst support for routine questions.
* Synthesize quantitative and qualitative insights to support product decisions and go/no\-go recommendations.


**Build the Product\-Operations Feedback Loop**
* Establish strong feedback mechanisms between frontline Operations, BPO partners, GDX, and Product teams.
* Aggregate and prioritize agent and operational feedback to identify recurring product opportunities and systemic issues.
* Convert frontline insights into structured recommendations that influence product roadmaps and future iterations.
* Close the loop with Operations and BPO partners by communicating how feedback has translated into product changes or decisions.


**Influence Through POD \& Cross\-Functional Engagement**
* Represent GSO Agent Experience in PODs and other cross\-functional forums.
* Build trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Customer Obsession, GDX, regional Operations, and BPO stakeholders.
* Advocate for agent needs while balancing product, technical, operational, and business considerations.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders when ownership or solutions span multiple teams, and escalate crisply when decisions stall.


**Enable Global Deployment \& Adoption**
* Partner with regional and BPO stakeholders to develop scalable deployment and adoption strategies for new capabilities across sites, vendors, languages, and lines of business.
* Work with BPO training, quality, and WFM teams to land enablement \- training materials, knowledge updates, floor support, and change communications.
* Monitor adoption and product health across markets and identify barriers to successful utilization.
* Diagnose differences in adoption or performance across regions, vendors, and sites, and develop targeted interventions.
* Capture learnings from deployments and use them to continuously improve future launch approaches.


**Advance AI\-First Agent Experience**
* Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve agent workflows and the way GSO manages product deployments.
* Support the rollout and evaluation of AI\-enabled support capabilities \- agent assist and copilots, automated summarization, AI\-driven knowledge retrieval, AI QA, and customer\-facing automation \- including how they change the agent's role and required skills.
* Harness AI to develop dashboards, webpages, launch trackers, playbooks, and knowledge assets that improve visibility into product health, launch readiness, and operational performance.
* Translate complex technical and product developments into clear narratives and actionable guidance for Operations and leadership.
* Champion AI\-first ways of working by automating documentation, reporting, analysis, and knowledge management where appropriate.
* Contribute to shaping the future of AI\-enabled customer support and Uber's Agent of the Future .


**What You'll Need**
**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Operations, Operations, Program Management, Customer Support Operations, UAT, or a related field.
* Direct BPO experience: Working within, operations, managing teams, or partnering with outsourced BPO/contact center operations. This includes hands\-on exposure to frontline agent workflows and day\-to\-day site realities (staffing, training, quality, floor support, adherence).
* Demonstrated experience working with external BPO vendors and site leadership to land change: running pilots or UAT with BPO agents, driving tool adoption across multiple sites or vendors, and managing performance conversations grounded in operational data.
* Experience working within customer support, contact center, or other large\-scale operational environments, and familiarity with core support metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, QA score, occupancy, adoption/utilization).
* Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous operational problems, structure them, and drive solutions across multiple stakeholders with minimal direction.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to combine operational data and qualitative insights into clear recommendations; comfortable working in spreadsheets and dashboards independently.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and operational audiences, and to present recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing multiple initiatives and stakeholders simultaneously in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional, multi\-timezone environment.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive initiatives from problem identification through implementation and measurement.
* Working knowledge of AI\-enabled customer support tools, agent\-assist technologies, and emerging applications of AI in Operations, with practical use of AI tools in your own workflow.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting or owning technology/product launches within customer operations at global scale.
* Experience operating in a multi\-vendor BPO model \- coordinating across several outsourcing partners, sites, and geographies with differing maturity levels.
* Familiarity with BPO commercial and governance constructs (SOWs, SLAs, QBRs, capacity and ramp planning) and how tooling changes affect them.
* Experience translating operational problems into business or product requirements (PRDs, BRDs, user stories).
* Familiarity with UAT methodologies, incubation, experimentation, pilot programs, A/B or holdout testing, and product efficacy measurement.
* Experience partnering directly with Product, Engineering, Design, or Technical Program Management teams.
* Experience evaluating AI/GenAI support capabilities in production \- measuring answer quality, deflection/containment, and agent trust and adoption.
* Experience using data to evaluate product adoption and operational impact; hands\-on with SQL, Tableau, Looker, Google Sheets, or similar.
* Experience developing scalable processes, frameworks, or operating models across multiple markets or teams.
* Experience with knowledge management, agent enablement, or support content operations.
* Demonstrated interest in AI, automation, and the future of customer support.


**Ready to Ride?**
 This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
   

  

 Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
   

  

 Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

title: Senior Test Engineer, Functional
description:
**About ValGenesis**
 ValGenesis is a leading digital validation platform provider for life sciences companies. ValGenesis suite of products are used by 30 of the top 50 global pharmaceutical and biotech companies to achieve digital transformation, total compliance and manufacturing excellence/intelligence across their product lifecycle.
   

  

 Learn more about working for ValGenesis, the de facto standard for paperless validation in Life Sciences: https://www.valgenesis.com/about
   

  

 About the Role:
   

  

 ValGenesis is looking for Senior QA/Test Engineers to join and strengthen our development team. Test engineers will be part of the development scrum teams, and will closely work with the developers, and Business Analysts/Project Managers to ensure that all digital products are properly verified before reaching the clients.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop deep expertise in our products and their uses in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Plan and execute computer system verification activities.
* Work with software developers and product managers in an Agile team environment.
* Create testing\-related documentation, including test plans, test cases/scripts, and bug reports assessing quality and associated risk.
* Ability to map data flows in the software as a basis to develop challenging and robust testing.
* Conduct QA tests and verify outcomes within schedules/timelines.


**Requirements**
* Prior experience/knowledge in Biopharma Industry, specifically pharma regulatory, quality, risk, and process validation.
* 5 \- 10 years of experience in Functional flow testing of all test phases.
* Experienceinf using or testing any pharma validation/quality software systems is a huge plus.
* Experience in leading/guiding junior team members.
* Experience using Jira.
* Proficient in MS Office and Test Design.
* Able to work both collaboratively and independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Able to work with minimal supervision.
* Good understanding of software development life cycle process.
* Experience with test automation frameworks (Robot, Selenium, etc) is preferable.


**We’re on a Mission**
 In 2005, we disrupted the life sciences industry by introducing the world’s first digital validation lifecycle management system. ValGenesis VLMS® revolutionized compliance\-based corporate validation activities and has remained the industry standard.
   

  

 Today, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation ― enhancing and expanding our portfolio beyond validation with an end\-to\-end digital transformation platform. We combine our purpose\-built systems with world\-class consulting services to help every facet of GxP meet evolving regulations and quality expectations.
   

  

**The Team You’ll Join**
 Our customers’ success is our success. We keep the customer experience centered in our decisions, from product to marketing to sales to services to support. Life sciences companies exist to improve humanity’s quality of life, and we honor that mission.
   

  

 We work together. We communicate openly, support each other without reservation, and never hesitate to wear multiple hats to get the job done.
   

  

 We think big. Innovation is the heart of ValGenesis. That spirit drives product development as well as personal growth. We never stop aiming upward.
   

  

 We’re in it to win it. We’re on a path to becoming the number one intelligent validation platform in the market, and we won’t settle for anything less than being a market leader.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Our Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore offices are onsite, 5 days per week. We believe that in\-person interaction and collaboration fosters creativity, and a sense of community, and is critical to our future success as a company.
   

  

 ValGenesis is an equal\-opportunity employer that makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. Our goal is to have the best\-qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics protected by local law.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Specialist, Technical Product Management
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Specialist, Technical Product Management, CRM**
**The Opportunity**
 Join a global biopharma company with a 130\-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data\-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
   

  

 Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
   

  

 This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Technical Product Manager, you will own and manage the product throughout its lifecycle, ensuring it delivers business value, supports user needs, and aligns with strategic priorities. You will partner with business stakeholders, technical SMEs, and delivery teams to define product vision, prioritize the backlog, and guide delivery of technical solutions. This role requires a balance of strategic thinking and technical understanding.
   

  

**What Will You Do In This Role**
* Own and manage the product across its full lifecycle, ensuring alignment to business needs, user experience, and strategic outcomes.
* Define and evolve the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and priorities to maximize value delivery and long\-term sustainability.
* Lead discovery and requirement definition activities.
* Create, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment to agreed priorities.
* Review requirements, change requests, and proposed solutions to ensure alignment with business objectives, technical feasibility, and regulatory needs.
* Drives delivery of product enhancements and releases through the agreed delivery and change management process.
* Monitor product performance, adoption, feedback, and key metrics.
* Identify risks, issues, dependencies, and impacts, and define mitigation actions to support successful delivery.
* Provide overall leadership, guidance, and management of all aspects of a given solution, including requirements gathering, enhancements delivery plan and implementation.
* Partner with business stakeholders, technical SMEs, solution architects, and development teams to translate needs into clear product solutions.
* Facilitate communication and coordination across delivery squads, stakeholders, and senior management.
* Evaluate Veeva CRM solutions that meet business needs with minimal customization, recommending standard Veeva features whenever possible.
* Stay current on new technologies, methodologies, industry practices, standards, and the Veeva CRM roadmap.
* Apply AI tools to improve daily work processes and productivity.


**What Should You Have**
 Educational requirement is mandatory. The years of experience for
 **R3 is fixed to 7\-11 years** 
 ,
 **do not alter** 
 . Skills are separated into
 **Primary and Secondary – this structure must be maintained** 
 to support HiredScore screening.
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 7\-11 years of experience in technical product management, service delivery and other related IT positions.


**Primary Skills (must\-have)**
* Solid knowledge of SDLC processes, including requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a customer\-focused environment.
* Proven background in strategic planning.
* Demonstrated ability in stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Strong understanding of technical and business processes impacts to support informed decision\-making.
* Familiarity with product management and agile methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead technical squads and coordinate end\-to\-end delivery.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead complex technical initiatives.


**Secondary Skills (nice To Have)**
* Exposure to larger\-scale transformation or enterprise delivery
* Familiarity with product metrics, adoption, and performance monitoring
* Solid technical background beyond product management
* Exposure to regulated or highly governed environments

title: Product Director, Metrics (Product Agility Tools)
description:
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 As a Product Director for the Metrics product area, you will own the strategy and execution for an internally developed enterprise\-wide product suite that serves as the backbone for how JPMorgan Chase measures the health and effectiveness of its products and cross\-functional agile delivery teams. Your platform encompasses the systems\-of\-record that provide executive\-to\-team visibility into delivery performance and organizational health.
   

  

 You will partner closely with engineering, design, data science, customer success, and business leaders to deliver best\-in\-class analytics solutions that drive measurable value. A critical dimension of this role is leading the agentic transformation of the Metrics product area: leveraging agentic tools to accelerate your team's product development lifecycle (PDLC), while simultaneously building next\-generation AI features and capabilities for your users.
   

  

 We're looking for a senior leader who combines deep product management expertise with a forward\-leaning perspective on AI and agentic tooling. You should be someone who can translate complex organizational data into actionable insights and who sees AI not just as a feature set, but as a fundamental accelerant for how products are built and consumed. The core of your role is driving product excellence, data quality, and operational impact across the organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Set Product Vision \& Strategy: Define and communicate a bold product vision and roadmap for the Metrics product area. Define and align the feature roadmap with organizational objectives, with a clear through\-line to JPMC's agentic transformation strategy.
* Measure Success: Establish, track, and continuously refine Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) for the Metrics product area to ensure product initiatives deliver measurable impact, drive alignment across teams, and support ongoing improvement.
* Lead Cross\-Functional Teams: Inspire and guide cross\-functional teams of product managers, UI/UX designers, software engineers, and data scientists to deliver innovative analytics solutions at scale, spanning APIs, data pipelines, modern web interfaces, and AI\-powered experiences.
* Drive Agile Execution: Champion agile methodologies, ensuring effective prioritization, sprint planning, and delivery of high\-value experiences. Model the same agile discipline your products measure.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build strong relationships with senior executives, delivery leads, engineering leaders, Line of Business Product \& Technology leaders, and control functions who depend on these platforms for quarterly business reviews, capacity planning, and organizational health assessments.
* Customer\-Centric Innovation: Collaborate with UX research and customer success functions to identify pain points and opportunities. Translate insights into actionable product enhancements that surface the "so what" behind the metrics.
* Operational Excellence: Oversee backlog health, testing, production readiness, and continuous improvement of product development processes. Ensure platform reliability for a user base that depends on these metrics for executive decision\-making.
* Mentor \& Develop Talent: Build and nurture a high\-performing product management team, fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and growth.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of product management experience, including leadership of complex, cross\-functional initiatives; bachelor's degree preferred.
* Proven track record of delivering enterprise\-scale data, analytics, or business intelligence products in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.
* Deep familiarity with agile delivery metrics and frameworks (e.g., Scrum, Kanban, etc.). Not just as a practitioner, but as someone who understands how to measure and improve them at organizational scale.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with AI/agentic tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate product development workflows.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a strategic, ownership mindset with the ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear product direction.
* Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence at all levels, from teams to C\-suite\-level stakeholders.
* Proficiency with product management, data and analytics tools (e.g., Jira, Adobe Analytics, Figma, Qualtrics, Databricks).
* Commitment and self\-motivation suitable to a startup\-pace team operating within a large financial institution.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience building internal, multi\-tenant enterprise platforms.
* Background in data products, data pipelines, or analytics platforms. Comfort with concepts like data aggregation, ETL, caching strategies, and API\-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with modern tech stacks (microservices, event\-driven architectures, cloud\-native platforms) sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams.
* Experience with cohort analysis, benchmarking methodologies, or statistical process control in a product context.


**ABOUT US**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

 Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

title: Technical Lead - Software Engineering
description:
**About The Position** 




 Aqua Security enables enterprises to secure their container\-based and cloud\-native applications from development to production, accelerating container adoption and bridging the gap between DevOps and IT security. We are building a state\-of\-the\-art security platform for large enterprises in the exciting and innovative new field of software containers. Our systems are deployed on thousands of customer servers around the world. A distributed system to watch over distributed systems!
 


* We are looking for a talented Technical Lead to join our server team, in charge of developing Aqua's management console \- a multi\-component system with many responsibilities, performing various background jobs and large\-scale data processing; supplying REST APIs, a web based UI and more.
* In this role, you will take part in further development of our management console, writing features across the entire application stack: SQL queries, business logic, background processes, REST APIs and web\-based user interfaces.
* At Aqua, you will not be writing code for in\-house applications. You will be writing code for large technology companies, banks, government agencies and multi\-national chains.
* Our product is composed of multiple components, mostly installed on\-premise in our customer's cloud environments, but also has SaaS components, plugins for various CI/CD systems and many more. Almost everything runs inside containers. It is written in Go \- an exciting new language from Google, and heavily depends on free software/open source components. Our web UI is currently written in VueJS. We are primarily a Linux company, but our software also supports Windows and Mac.



  





**Working from Aqua Hyderabad office a minimum of 4 days per week (Mon\-Thu)** 




**Requirements** 



1. 9\+ years of hands\-on engineering experience delivering features for large\-scale, distributed applications.
2. Proven experience designing and building multi‑component systems / microservices with efficient inter‑service communication patterns.
3. Strong programming background in Go, Node.js, Java, or similar high\-level languages — extra credit if you’ve used Go in production or survived a weekend debugging a catastrophic memory leak.
4. Experienced in building and maintaining APIs (REST or RPC) while owning the lifecycle of backward‑compatibility decisions (including the ones you regret).
5. Passionate about modern engineering practices, open\-source ecosystems, and developing software that runs reliably at scale in real customer environments.



  





**AI \& GenAI Expertise** 



1. Practical, high\-impact experience using GenAI development tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, etc.) to boost developer productivity, accelerate code reviews, support architectural decisions, and improve engineering workflows.
2. Familiarity with AI\-supported observability, predictive alerting, data analysis and intelligent root‑cause analysis.
3. Experience integrating AI/ML\-assisted tooling into design, development, test automation, CI/CD, or operational pipelines is a strong plus.



  





**Data \& Storage Technologies** 



1. Deep hands\-on experience with RDBMS (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQLite) and/or NoSQL systems (MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Couchbase).
2. Comfortable writing complex queries (yes, including multi‑join monsters) and having strong opinions on integer vs UUIDprimary keys.
3. Bonus points for familiarity with Graph Databases.



  





**Cloud, Infra \& DevOps** 



1. Solid, production\-grade experience on AWS (required).
2. Strong knowledge of IaC tooling, automated provisioning, and cloud\-native infrastructure design.
3. Experience building cloud\-native apps using Serverless (Lambda), SNS, SQS, S3, EC2, and event\-driven architectures.
4. Understanding of AI\-supported IaC, automated configuration checks, and intelligent cloud monitoring is a plus.



  





**Containers, Linux \& Ecosystem** 



1. Strong Linux fundamentals — you should feel at home in \*nix environments.
2. Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (required); OpenShift is a bonus.
3. Knowledge of event streaming platforms like Kafka is a plus.



  





 Aqua Security is the pioneer in cloud native security. Founded in 2015, Aqua Security is a global late\-stage scale\-up and the largest pure play cloud native vendor. Aqua helps enterprises see and stop threats across every phase of the software development lifecycle, from dev to cloud and back.
 



 If you’re ready for an exciting opportunity to dive into the hottest cybersecurity category, now is the perfect time to join Aqua! We are a global organization where every Aquarian can make a difference and make a big impact. Aqua also offers great company culture, amazing colleagues, international travel, and lots more!
 



 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Senior Product Specialist
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Applied AI Senior Product Specialist
   

  

 An Applied AI Senior Product Specialist is a mid\-level individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross\-function al product teams to solve customer problems that align with business needs. Being a mid\-level product management role, you will have the opportunity to own products of lesser complexity that drive business value. The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist, like any of our product managers, is accountable for the product’s success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. This role harnesses AI and agentic tools to compress the concept\-to\-cas h learning loop—automatin g analysis, prototyping, and compliance detail\-work so the team can focus on the human judgment AI cannot replace: product sense\-making.
   

  

 The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist plays a crucial role in ensuring the success of our less complex yet valuable products by balancing customer needs with business objectives. This role requires a blend of strategic vision, analytical skills, and collaborative teamwork to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. It demands some experience in the modern product management craft and a drive for continuous improvement—am plified by the fluent, responsible use of AI to learn faster and earn faster.
   

  

 Work you’ll do
   

  

* Product Accountability
* Responsible and accountable for the product's value and viability showcasing a measurable Return on Investments (ROI)
* Drive strategy\-align ed solutions to achieve product value objectives.
* Formulate and achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for identified problems to solve.
* Measure KPIs and analyze outcomes to inform future strategies.
* Leverage AI to harvest outcome evidence early and often, lowering total cost of ownership (TCO).
* Vision and Strategy
* Co\-create, own, and evangelize the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, using AI to deepen domain knowledge and simulate future scenarios to chart pathways others have not yet seen.
* Align product objectives with the product line and business goals.
* Co\-create in collaboration with business stakeholders, engineering, experience, and delivery.
* Market and User Engagement
* Conduct user research and competitive analysis, using AI agents to synthesize research at speed—accelera ting the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
* Engage the team with users and stakeholders through continuous research and direct interactions.
* Collaborate and guide the team toward solutions that address priority user and business needs.
* Collaboration and Teamwork
* Work side\-by\-side with cross\-function al (business, engineering, experience, and delivery) team members to achieve KPI outcomes.
* Promote a product operating model that emphasizes outcomes over output (minimize overproduction while maximizing value).
* Build empowered teams and product communities who exhibit collective product ownership.
* Continuous Improvement
* Remove obstacles for the team and ensure smooth flow of continuous value achievement.
* Promote and drive rapid, emergent, and ongoing learning and adaptation to meet objectives.
* Drive innovation and improvement of the process to drive out waste and accelerate value achievement, using AI as a force\-multipli er to offload the repetitive, speed up the sluggish, and automate the mundane.
* Spread knowledge and best practices within the product vertical community.
* Applied AI Ways of Working
* Amplify innovation: use AI to rapidly deepen domain knowledge, surface untapped market and user potential, and simulate future scenarios—char ting new pathways for the business rather than only collecting requirements.
* Amplify learning: use AI agents to synthesize research and validate ideas before they enter the backlog—compre ssing lead time by accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
* Amplify focus: act as Editor\-in\-Chie f—using AI to rigorously test assumptions and retire ideas that do not genuinely serve the user’s workflow in a way that works for the business.
* Amplify experimentatio n: use AI to build early, functional, disposable prototypes that validate the architecture and the solution, playing a key role in the Agentic Secure Software Development Life Cycle that paves a clear path for engineering to productionize.


 The successful candidate will possess:
   

  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others


 The team
   

  

 Deloitte Product Engineering (PxE) is developing advanced, agentic AI\-enabled solutions that are redefining the future of work across our organization and for global clients. We are committed to bringing together outstanding product, engineering, and design talent to lead this t ransformation.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of proven experience in product management or related roles.
* 1\+ years of building AI based intelligent products
* 1\+ year’s experience in using GenAI tools to perform product management tasks like conduct idea research, shaping, synthesis, roadmaps, requirements, prototyping, testing
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
* Ability to travel 0\-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sec tors you serve
* Ability to work in your local office at a minimum of 3 days per week
* Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to one of the select location available for this role


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience being accountable for value and viability results for an empowered product team.
* Experience in modern product craft of delivering the right thing, in the right way, at the right time.
* Experience in modern product management craft and domain (tools, methods, and practices).
* Experience with lean solutions and rapid, inexpensive experimentatio n to emerge the right thing, in the right way, at the right time.
* Accountability for value, viability and P\&L objectives for a product.
* Quick to reach expert\-level knowledge within the product domain being served.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data and derive actionable insights.
* Problem\-Solvin g: Innovative and experimental approach to solving complex problems.
* Leadership: Ability to lead and inspire cross\-function al teams, fostering collaboration and collective movement toward product goals.
* Customer\-Centr icity: Deep understanding of customer needs and engagement patterns, driving teams to deliver solutions that customers love and that work for the business.
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute a strategic vision for the product, aligning it with broader business objectives.
* AI Agentic Fluency: Comfortable orchestrating multiple AI agents across the concept\-to\-cas h flow (research, insight, prototyping, specification, coding, and compliance), with guardrails at each hand\-off—assum ptions, confidence levels, and links to sources of truth.
* AI Realism and Eval Fluency: Understands the difference between deterministic logic and probabilistic generation; designs guardrails for hallucination, bias, and drift; uses evaluation harnesses before launch and monitors drift after, with a kill\-switch mentality—and knows when not to use AI.


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. **Job Description**
 Make your mark by using Agentic AI to shape how teams build trusted and AI\-ready data at scale as they go through the Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC). Join the Firmwide Chief Data Office at JPMorganChase where your work directly improves speed, quality, and governance in data delivery. Bring your product mindset and technical fluency to help design a platform that grows your career through high\-impact, enterprise\-wide collaboration.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As an Agentic AI Lead for the DDLC at JPMorganChase, you will help build and scale an agentic artificial intelligence solution that enables Data Product Managers to execute the end\-to\-end Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC) – from ideation and modeling through publishing, governance, and consumption. You will translate business needs into a clear technical roadmap, validate engineering delivery, and improve how teams publish and consume governed data products. You will partner closely with engineering and business stakeholders to define success measures, evaluate capability releases, and drive adoption across multiple business areas.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, data product delivery, and software engineering execution. Your knowledge of agentic best practices will help build out the architecture for this solution including skills, tools and the harness. Your knowledge of data engineering/science best practices will help translate business needs into technical solutions. You will run structured discovery with business stakeholders to understand current workflows and friction points, then convert those insights into prioritized requirements and measurable outcomes. You will also support executive communications by synthesizing progress into concise narratives, metrics, and roadmap updates.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Define end\-to\-end requirements for the build of an agentic solution for the data persona that enables end\-to\-end data product development, in alignment with firmwide data guidelines and standards.
* Lead discovery with business teams to document current workflows, identify friction points, and translate needs into a prioritized intake backlog. Also demonstrate how the agent addresses these pain points.
* Design and run structured user\-feedback loops (interviews, shadowing sessions, usability tests, telemetry review) to continuously refine tool capabilities against real DPM workflows.
* Partner with engineering leads to convert business needs into well\-scoped technical requirements and discrete, assignable tasks for data engineers and AI engineers.

description:

**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Product Specialist II**
 An Applied AI Product Specialist II is a mid\-level individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross\-functional product teams to solve customer problems that align with business needs.  The Applied AI Product Specialist II plays a crucial role in ensuring the success of our less complex yet valuable products by balancing customer needs with business objectives. This role requires a blend of strategic vision, analytical skills, and collaborative teamwork to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. It demands some experience in the modern product management craft and a drive for continuous improvement—amplified by the fluent, responsible use of AI to learn faster and earn faster.
